answer: To vote on yarrow evidence for a jade relic's provenance, each AI key must store a 1-GiB evidence replica under an independent one-time pad for 30 days. Validators bind its Merkle root to key and round and demand daily random openings; failure voids the vote. No replica backs two keys, so n keys reserve n GiB for 30 days. Hardware is reusable; occupied capacity is the cost. Issuers must use true random pads, not seeded streams, or regeneration erases the bound. Issuer collusion and sampling errors permit cheating; wealth still buys capacity.
